messages:
Emily K: Hey folks — clearing out my desk area. Free to a good home: 2x 27" Dell U2720Q monitors (DisplayPort + USB-C), both 4K 3840x2160; one has a tiny scratch on the bezel. Also an electric VARIER standing desk (works fine) and 2 digital SF Giants tickets for Aug 5. Pickup at SF office (2nd floor) today or tomorrow. First come, first serve! :sparkles: 

Raj P: Nice — are those the 60Hz models or 1440p?

Emily K: 60Hz, 4K panels (so 60Hz at 3840x2160). No 144Hz. Connectors: 1x USB-C (power + video), 1x DP, 1x HDMI. Comes with DP cable.

Sara M: I can take both monitors if nobody beats me to it. Can pick up tomorrow AM. :raised_hands:

Ben L: I need a standing desk — what's the footprint? And can you help move it downstairs?

Emily K: Desk footprint ~ 60in x 30in. Electric motor works. I can help carry it down but facilities ask folks to log big removals.

Facilities Bot: @channel Reminder: please file a furniture-move ticket at https://intra.redwood.com/facilities before removing bulky items from the office. This helps us reserve elevators and ramps.

Emily K: Thanks — just filed the ticket (FT-4721).

Jen O: I'll take the 2 Giants tickets! DM me the transfer link.

Raj P: If the monitors fall through, I can take one. Thanks for giving them away. :)

Sara M: Confirming I'll pick up the monitors tomorrow at 9:30am by the mailroom. Emily, should I bring anything (strap/box)?

Emily K: 9:30 works. If you have a second person to help that’s ideal. I have one original box but it's taped — straps will help.

Ben L: Cool. If Sara can't handle the desk, I can pick it up Sunday and I can help with carrying.

Emily K: Sounds good — Sara, if desk is available, do you want it? Otherwise Ben is next.

Sara M: Desk is too big for my place, so Ben you can have it. Thanks Emily! :wave:

Ben L: Amazing, I’ll bring a dolly and coordinate with Facilities. Thanks!

Emily K: Everyone — monitors and desk spoken for (Sara for monitors, Ben for desk). Jen has the tickets. Raj — noted in case something changes. Thanks team :heart:

Facilities Bot: Note: please leave any packing materials in the marked bin on the loading dock.

Raj P: Thanks for sharing — appreciate it!
